plane3d_racetrack-v3.note: Failure modes (base.failure_kernel): continuing stays the default (a trip is charged and the plant restarts, terminated stays false); params.continuing = False now ends the episode on a trip instead. Each restart draws from a per-step key (base.restart_key) instead of the raw rollout key, so a run of trips no longer replays the initial state; info["trip_cost"] reports the lump the reward already charges. No recorded baseline or protocol row trips, and a full re-record reproduced every one bit for bit. Earlier: Behaviour-preserving: only rho_floor and rho_floor_tracking moved, from 1.07 to 0.487, when the racetrack oracle went from 50 to 200 descent iterations and its holds were re-measured (0.6803 m altitude, 0.4660 m path, lowest per seed). The floors (1 m, 3 m), failure_cost and every other parameter are unchanged, and neither rho enters the reward: it is the NEA reference, and the planner never applies done_value. Later re-stamped in place: Behaviour-preserving: the plane3d and patrol env classes gained make_pid/make_mpc (via the RegistryExperts mixin in expert_access.py) and a registry_name attribute. They only look up the registry's controllers; no physics, reward or parameter changed. The baselines and protocol rows re-recorded on the same tree reproduce the previous returns. Later re-stamped in place: Behaviour-preserving: each env class now takes make_pid and expert_policy from the RegistryExperts mixin (expert_access.py, resolved through the registry) instead of defining them itself, and the shipped PIDs moved out of experts/pid.py into each package's experts.py as pure Controllers. No physics, reward or parameter changed.
